ux_intent: Validate the layout, states, and interaction patterns for the Playback screen as described in story 'WCAG Phase 2 Fixes: focus ordering, SeekBar announcements, error messages, gesture alternatives'. The prototype should prove that the key user flows are visually clear and that accessibility requirements (tap targets, contrast, text sizing) are met.
figma_make_prompt:
Design a mobile screen for: Playback.


Platform: Android/iOS phone. Base frame: 390 x 844.
Top app bar with back arrow and screen title. Bottom navigation bar.

Layout:
  - Horizontal page padding: 16px
  - Component gap: 12px
  - Section gap: 24px

Key elements (from story scope):
  - Add explicit focus ordering (nextFocusDown, nextFocusForward) to all multi-element forms: advanced search, ebook highlight menu, ebook reader toolbar
  - Set touch_interceptor to focusable=false and importantForAccessibility=no so keyboard focus reaches ebook reader controls
  - Add dynamic value announcements to the audiobook SeekBar (current position and total duration)
  - Add dynamic value announcements to the ebook progress SeekBar
  - Audit strings.xml for generic error messages and replace them with specific, actionable messages mapped to HTTP status codes
  - Verify that ebook page turning has a non-gesture alternative (tap zones or explicit buttons); add buttons if absent

States: Default state, Error state (show error message with retry button), Empty state (show placeholder message).

Behavior:
  - All interactive elements respond to tap with visual feedback.
  - Navigation transitions use slide animation.

Style:
  - Primary color: #6366F1
  - Error color: #EF4444
  - Background: #F9FAFB
  - Surface: #FFFFFF
  - Text primary: #121212
  - Body text: 16sp
  - Card corner radius: 12px
  - Button corner radius: 8px
  - Use auto layout on every frame.
  - Material 3 design language.

All tap targets must be at least 48x48dp.
All body text at least 14sp.
Colour contrast must meet WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.

First step: Create the default state with all layout elements positioned and styled.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the app encounters an HTTP error (e.g., 401, 403, 404, 500, timeout)
When the error is displayed to the user
Then the message is specific and actionable (e.g., "Session expired — please sign in again" for 401), not a generic "An error occurred"
manual_validation_checklist: Layout spacing matches spec: page padding 16px, component gap 12px, section gap 24px
All three states present: default, error, empty
All tap targets are at least 48x48dp
Colour contrast meets WCAG AA: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text
Auto layout is applied to every frame
Card corners are 12px, button corners are 8px
Responsive: content reflows correctly if frame width changes by ±50px
